note: Explainable: linear weights over character n-grams, bge-base embedding dimensions, amount, sign and channel show what drove each category. Operations: CPU only (scikit-learn + ONNX bge-base, about 130 MB), about 12k rows/s per process and 2.1 GB peak at 20k-row batches; retraining one configuration takes about 14 minutes on a laptop CPU. Known issue: on unseen merchants Travel is the fallback guess (30% of rows, nearly all wrong, confidence about 0.5); FR-5 review and feedback retraining are the remedy.

Explainable: linear weights over character n-grams, bge-small embedding dimensions, amount, sign, channel and hour show what drove each category. Trained on clean labels (label_noise 0) without class weights. Operations: CPU only (scikit-learn + ONNX bge-small, about 67 MB); about 1.3 s per 10k-row batch in the round. Retraining: about 6 minutes for a comparison run and 3 for its twin on a laptop CPU. Known issues: on unseen merchants Health & Fitness is barely predicted (validation F1 0.105; its rows go to Utilities and Shopping) and Entertainment is confused with Dining (0.49): diagnosed, to be fixed after launch through feedback.
